description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Attach Fire], [Awoken Fire], [Damage Cap +10000], [Fire Warrior Mode] and [Martial Flames Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Fire
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Fire Warrior Mode
description.text: Grants [Soul Break Gauge +250] and [High Quick Cast 1] to the user after using three Fire abilities, removed after triggering

description.name: Martial Flames Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Martial Flames after using a Fire ability
